_note: ADR-047 / ADR-031 Phase-3 consumer: pipelinq's NL jurisdiction AVG/DSAR policy pack, shipped as DATA (not a PHP PolicyService). It is a single dsarPolicyPack object seeded onto OpenRegister's core `dsar-policy-packs` register (owned by OR, seeded at OR install). pipelinq does NOT redefine that register/schema here (avoids the register-import union-merge corruption, ADR-037) — it only adds this object via the additive `components.objects` seed list, imported through OR's ConfigurationService on the existing SettingsService/InitializeSettings path. Every id/token/role is a safe placeholder. The two seam selectors (identityVerifyProvider / regulatorEscalateProvider) name the provider ids pipelinq self-registers into OR's registries at boot (lib/AppInfo/Application.php). All property names conform to OR's released dsarPolicyPack schema (lib/Settings/dsar_policy_pack_register.json).
